headline: General election work, including possible votes, during an all-day session.
summary: The meeting covers the General Election. Votes may be taken during the all-day session.
items: Conduct the November 3, 2026 General Election, with the board in session all day
location: Room 303, Pawtucket City Hall, 137 Roosevelt Ave.
